admin.intro: Translate this forum's interface with your own AI or translation provider: find what each language is missing, check the cost, translate, review every string, then save it to Linguist or export a language pack. Every placeholder is checked before a string can be saved.

provider.kind_llm: A language model: reads the key and context of each string, keeps placeholders, follows your glossary and tone.
provider.kind_mt: A translation engine: fast and inexpensive. Placeholders and plurals are hidden from it and put back afterwards; it can't follow notes.
provider.key_replace: Paste a new key to replace it
provider.key_remove_confirm: Remove the saved key for this provider?
provider.key_help: Stored encrypted on this server, used only from the server, and never shown again.
provider.base_url_help: The server's OpenAI-compatible address, ending in /v1. Must be https unless it is on this machine or your network.
provider.allow_local_help: Lets Phrasebook call addresses on this server or your private network (localhost, 192.168.x.x, Docker service names, Tailscale). Leave off unless your model runs there. Cloud metadata addresses stay blocked either way.
provider.model_placeholder: Pick from the list or type a model id
provider.models_count: {count, plural, one {# model available} other {# models available}}. Type any model id the provider accepts.
provider.models_failed: Couldn't load the model list: {reason}. You can still type a model id.
provider.effort_help: For models that think before answering (Claude, OpenAI's reasoning models). Interface strings rarely need more than low; higher costs more.
provider.batch_size_help: Smaller batches are retried more cheaply; larger ones share the instructions across more strings.
provider.price_source_built_in: Using the provider's published price shown in grey; enter your own to override it.
provider.price_source_listed: Using the price OpenRouter lists for this model; enter your own to override it.
provider.price_source_local: Runs on your own hardware: free.
provider.price_source_free: DeepL Free key: free within your monthly allowance.
provider.price_unknown: Phrasebook doesn't know this model's price. Enter it so the budget cap can hold; a run won't start without one.

translate.languages_help: Installed language packs are listed. Add a code to start a new language that has no pack yet.
translate.no_packs: No language pack is installed. Add a language code to start one.
translate.scan_summary: {missing} missing, {stale} out of date, {identical} same as English, out of {total} strings.
translate.complete: Nothing to do for this language.
translate.which_help: Out of date: the English changed after it was translated, or a placeholder no longer matches. Same as English is often right (OK, brand names), so it is off by default.
translate.notes_help: For example: "Use du, not Sie" or "This is a forum for car enthusiasts".
translate.glossary_help: One term per line: term = translation. A term on its own stays untranslated. DeepL uses it as a DeepL glossary.
translate.glossary_google: Google Translation (Basic) can't use a glossary or tone.
translate.budget_help: A hard cap: before each request Phrasebook checks the most it could cost, and pauses the run rather than go over.
translate.no_model: Choose a provider and model first.
translate.estimate_first: Estimate the cost first; then you can start.
translate.estimate_llm: {strings} strings in {batches} requests, about {input} tokens in and {output} out.
translate.estimate_help: The range covers longer translations, thinking and retries. The budget is what actually caps it.
translate.no_price: No price is known for this model: enter one on the Provider tab to start.

runs.none: No runs yet. Start one on the Translate tab.
runs.save_confirm: Save {count} accepted strings as Linguist overrides for {locale}? They take effect on the forum right away.
runs.saved_message: {saved} saved to Linguist. {skipped} skipped (key too long or no longer valid).
runs.not_installed: No language pack for {locale} is installed, so the forum can't show them yet: export a language pack below, or install one.
runs.delete_confirm: Delete this run and its translations? Strings already saved to Linguist stay.
runs.linguist_outdated: Update FoF Linguist to 2.0.0 or newer first (composer update fof/linguist): older versions show placeholders wrongly in text the server writes, such as emails.
runs.linguist_missing: Enable FoF Linguist to save straight to the forum, or export a file below.
runs.paused_budget: Paused: the next request could go over the budget.
runs.paused_price: Paused: this model has no price. Enter one on the Provider tab, then resume.
runs.keep_open: This forum has no queue worker, so this page does the translating: keep it open until the run is ready for review.
runs.queued_note: Running on the queue. You can leave this page.

export.title: Export
export.scope_full: Everything this language has, with these on top
export.help: Exports accepted and saved strings. A language pack is a complete Flarum extension: set your vendor name in composer.json before you publish it.

validation.reference: It can't start with =>, which Flarum reads as a reference to another string.
validation.too_long: It is far longer than the English.
validation.syntax: It isn't valid ICU MessageFormat ({detail}). An apostrophe directly before a placeholder must be doubled.
validation.argument_type: The placeholder {detail} changed its form (plural, select or number).
validation.argument_added: {detail} isn't a placeholder of the English.
validation.select_added: A select branch isn't in the English: {detail}.
validation.plural_exact_missing: An exact plural case is missing: {detail}.
validation.plural_form_missing: A plural form this language needs is missing: {detail}.
validation.tag_added: The tag {detail} isn't in the English.
validation.markup: It contains markup the English doesn't have.
validation.no_answer: The provider returned no translation for this string.

failure.quota: The account is out of credit or over its quota.
failure.model: The provider doesn't know this model.
failure.invalid_response: The provider's answer couldn't be read.

net.url: the address isn't a valid URL
net.scheme: only http and https are allowed
net.credentials: the address can't contain a user name or password
net.local_disabled: it's on this machine or your network: switch on Allow local models
net.https_required: plain http is only allowed for local models; use https

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.locale_invalid: That isn't a language code (examples: de, pt_BR, zh_Hans).
errors.locales_run_active: This language already has a run with strings waiting for you. Save, reject or delete them first (Runs tab).
errors.model_invalid: Choose a model on the Provider tab.
errors.provider_invalid: Choose a provider on the Provider tab.
errors.price_required: This model has no price: enter one on the Provider tab.
errors.key_required: Save an API key on the Provider tab first.
errors.key_invalid: That doesn't look like an API key.
errors.budget_invalid: Enter a budget above zero (up to 10000).
errors.notes_too_long: The notes are too long (1000 characters at most).
errors.strings_nothing_to_translate: Nothing to translate with these choices.
errors.strings_too_many: Too many strings for one run (20,000 at most): pick fewer extensions.
errors.locale_nothing_to_export: Nothing accepted for this language yet.
errors.format_zip_unavailable: This server's PHP has no zip extension; export the YAML file instead.
